newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weaker across the barrel.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weaker across the barrel.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Friday, knocked by easier crude and insubstantial demand.
Naphtha tumbled $10-$15 and into contango on anemic end-user demand, lower crude prices, and traders pushing down the swaps before they load cargoes out of the Med for Japan.
Gasoline drifted $2 lower tracking weaker futures prices.
High sulphur fuel oil was weaker, while low sulphur strengthened by a couple of dollars.
Gas oil was squeezed up to $3 a tonne lower by weaker futures and easier premiums prompted by relaxed buying interest.
